integrity: The complete foundational Hastings–Powell article was inspected at the model, nondimensionalization, parameter, bifurcation, and chaotic-attractor sections. The complete 25-page Klebanoff–Hastings mathematical treatment was inspected through its general food-chain formulation, Hastings–Powell specialization, fixed points, normal-form analysis, global bifurcations, and conclusions. The open Coria global-dynamics treatment was compared for invariant-set localization and nonexistence/persistence statements. The three per-capita conditional laws, variance-speed decompositions, equality rigidity, Jensen break-even bound, and periodic crossing theorem were independently reconstructed, and their algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes compact invariant support strictly inside the positive orthant and does not apply to extinction-boundary invariant measures.
It does not prove existence of a positive chaotic invariant measure for arbitrary parameters.
The conditional laws determine selected conditional means rather than the complete stationary distribution.
The break-even inequality is necessary, not sufficient, for top-predator persistence.
Integrated per-capita growth balances are standard ecological consequences; the originality claim is the stronger fiberwise disintegration and exact speed-defect structure.
A short equivalent conditional identity could remain in unindexed ecological-dynamics literature.
title: Fiberwise trophic-flux calibration in the Hastings–Powell food chain
